commit.message: docs(dcp): add secure mcp tunnel validation guide

invariants: All examples use placeholders.
Tunnel only points to facade, never backend services.
Docs require loopback binding.
Docs say developer mode can expose read/write tools, so facade denylist is mandatory.
No secrets committed.
OUT OF SCOPE: No real tunnel ID/API keys/secrets.
OUT OF SCOPE: No running tunnel-client in CI.
OUT OF SCOPE: No connector creation automation.
OUT OF SCOPE: No code changes unless small config sample fixtures under docs.
OUT OF SCOPE: No public ingress.
STOP IF: Official tunnel behavior contradicts docs.
STOP IF: Tunnel requires root privileges.
STOP IF: Tunnel requires storing credentials unencrypted in repo.
STOP IF: Manual validation requires public ingress or backend direct exposure.
STOP IF: Secret scan finds real credentials.
FORBIDDEN FILE: services/** except if updating README under services/dcp-readonly-facade is strictly needed
FORBIDDEN FILE: src/**
FORBIDDEN FILE: .env*
FORBIDDEN FILE: .dopemux/**
FORBIDDEN FILE: compose*.yml
